outcome: Hemodynamic changes (MAP, HR, SpO2, body temperature)
cohort: 74 ASA II and III obstetric mothers undergoing cesarean section from December 2017 to March 2018.
finding: Both tramadol and meperidine effectively controlled shivering in mothers undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia, with tramadol showing faster onset, less recurrence, and less sedation.
